name: insta-buddy

scripts.site:build: npm run site:build:app && vite build --config site/vite.config.ts
scripts.desktop: npm run electron:build && npm run build && electron .
scripts.desktop:package: npm run build && npm run electron:build && electron-builder --publish never
scripts.desktop:package:dir: npm run build && npm run electron:build && electron-builder --dir --publish never
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test:ai && npm run test:electron
scripts.desktop:package:win: npm run build && npm run electron:build && electron-builder --win nsis --publish never
scripts.desktop:package:mac: npm run build && npm run electron:build && electron-builder --mac dmg --publish never
scripts.desktop:package:linux: npm run build && npm run electron:build && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb --publish never

description: Sort, cull, touch up and caption a holiday photo dump — on-device, with optional AI providers.
author: Insta Buddy
